method: Headlines collected via web search (fetch_news.py collector blocked in sandbox; use it for local/Actions runs). Entity sentiment scored by Claude during the weekly Cowork routine. sentiment = 0-100 D-favorability of coverage tone (matches existing dashboard sentimentScore semantics: >55 leans D, <45 leans R). candidateSentiment = 0-100 favorability of coverage toward that candidate personally. outletLean: -2 left ... +2 right (AllSides-style); null = unrated outlet, excluded from scatter.

races.matchup: Susan Collins (R, inc.) vs. Troy Jackson (D)
races.summary: A top-tier competitive race in which coverage frames five-term incumbent Susan Collins as vulnerable while Democrat Troy Jackson holds a narrow lead. Recent polling shows Jackson ahead: Fox News (Aug 6-10) had him +2, and an Abacus survey (Aug 28) put him up 52-43. Latest news (Sept 4) covers the two agreeing to four October debates. Cook rates the race a toss-up.

articles.headline: Troy Jackson agrees to 4 debates against Susan Collins in Maine Senate race
Where things stand in the Susan Collins-Troy Jackson Maine Senate race
In a competitive Maine Senate race, women voters could be the deciders
Maine voters have strong feelings about Susan Collins, new poll finds

races.summary: Open-seat race (Gov. Janet Mills term-limited) that coverage consistently frames as Democrat Hannah Pingree's to lose. A UNH poll had Pingree 49% to Charles's 35% and independent Rick Bennett's 6%; Pingree also dominates fundraising ($3M+). Most datable coverage in the window is a Sept 1 report on the candidates agreeing to four debates.

Hannah Pingree leads Bobby Charles in Maine governor's race poll
Poll of Maine governor's race gives Hannah Pingree comfortable lead over Bobby Charles

races.summary: Open-seat toss-up with Democrat Abdul El-Sayed holding a slight edge in most recent polling: MSU had him 50-45, Forbes' roundup ~+4, while a Fox News poll gave Rogers 51-47. A dominant storyline is debate scheduling, with El-Sayed hammering Rogers as 'Mike Dodgers' for not committing to more debates.

races.summary: Open-seat race (Gov. Whitmer term-limited) between Democrat Jocelyn Benson and Trump-endorsed Rep. John James. Polling favors Benson: MSU had her 52-43, an EPIC-MRA poll (Aug 22-28) 45-41; forecasters give her ~79% win probability. Coverage in the window is largely local candidate profiles and head-to-head framing.

articles.headline: Full interviews: Hear from Benson, James as they face off in Michigan gubernatorial race
Michigan governor's race enters general election after Benson, James primary wins

races.matchup: Jon Husted (R, inc.) vs. Sherrod Brown (D)
races.summary: Competitive special election (to finish JD Vance's term) between appointed GOP Sen. Jon Husted and Democratic former Sen. Sherrod Brown. Polling is mixed: a Fox News poll (Aug 6-10) had Brown +8 and an Abacus survey (Aug 28) +6, while Emerson showed Husted narrowly ahead. Brown is pressing a data-center/economic offensive; Husted countered with a $1.2M ad.

articles.headline: Brown's offensive on data centers defines his Ohio Senate fight with Husted
Sherrod Brown leads Husted by 8 as inflation tops Ohio Senate poll
What Sherrod Brown Has to Do to Beat Jon Husted in Ohio

races.summary: The open-seat race to succeed Mike DeWine is one of the nation's closest, with the RCP average roughly Acton 47 / Ramaswamy 47. Recent coverage centered on Acton's refusal to debate Ramaswamy (Sept 3) and a Sept 6-7 incident in which an armed GOP voter charged at Acton at a county fair. Ramaswamy retains a large cash advantage aided by a ~$25M personal loan.

races.summary: In the open-seat race for Thom Tillis's retiring seat, former Democratic Gov. Roy Cooper holds a consistent double-digit lead: the Carolina Journal/Harper poll (Aug 9-10) put Cooper up 52-39, and Elon showed +11. Cooper leads among independents by ~20 points and has out-raised Whatley more than 2-to-1. September coverage focused on the affordability ad war.

CJ poll: Cooper stretches lead over Whatley in US Senate race

races.matchup: Mike Collins (R) vs. Jon Ossoff (D, inc.)
races.summary: Democratic incumbent Jon Ossoff leads Republican Rep. Mike Collins, though the margin has narrowed: an InsiderAdvantage poll (Aug 16-17) showed Ossoff up 50-43, down from +13 in July. Ossoff enters the fall with a large cash advantage (~$25M). Coverage highlighted stark policy contrasts and dueling attack ads.

Aug. 29 - Latest Polls show Sen. Jon Ossoff holds his lead over Rep. Mike Collins

races.matchup: Rick Jackson (R) vs. Keisha Lance Bottoms (D)
races.summary: The open-seat race to succeed term-limited Brian Kemp is essentially tied ('dead even' per the mid-August InsiderAdvantage poll). GOP healthcare executive Rick Jackson, who spent $100M+ to win the runoff, is running heavy ads against former Atlanta Mayor Keisha Lance Bottoms; recent coverage was dominated by a debate-schedule feud and Bottoms rolling out a grocery-tax-relief and Medicaid agenda (Sept 2 AJC interview).

races.summary: Republican Rep. Ashley Hinson leads Democratic state Rep. Josh Turek in the open-seat race, with the September Emerson/Nexstar poll (Aug 31-Sep 1) showing Hinson up 50-45. The RCP average shows Hinson ahead by ~4. Turek narrowly leads among independents, and there is notable ticket-splitting as Democrat Rob Sand leads the concurrent governor's race.

New poll shows tight races for Iowa governor, U.S. Senate in 2026

races.summary: Open-seat race (Gov. Reynolds retiring). Democrat Rob Sand leads Republican Zach Lahn, who won an upset primary over Trump-backed Randy Feenstra. A Sept 3 Emerson/Nexstar poll had Sand up 49-46; Sand carries independents by ~26 points. Coverage tilts favorable to Sand, who posts the field's best favorability while Lahn faces scrutiny over his Kansas residency.

races.matchup: Joe Lombardo (R, inc.) vs. Aaron Ford (D)
races.summary: As of early September the race is defined by a sharp split over data centers: Ford (D) says they are 'jacking up' utility bills and draining water while Lombardo (R) backs them as economic growth with guardrails. Lombardo is running ads tying Ford to Gavin Newsom; Ford has challenged Lombardo to three televised debates. Public polling has ranged from a dead heat to single-digit GOP-commissioned leads.

articles.headline: Joe Lombardo and Aaron Ford split over economic and environmental impact of data centers
Nevada Governor's race: Sorting through the candidates' campaign ads and appearances

races.summary: Open-seat contest between Democrat David Crowley (Milwaukee County executive), who narrowly won an Aug 11 primary over Francesca Hong, and Republican Rep. Tom Tiffany. A Democratic-affiliated poll (Aug 12) showed Crowley up 3, within the margin. Public education and data centers are early flashpoints; Tiffany is on the attack over Crowley's data-center stance.

articles.headline: Wisconsin Governor's race remains quiet as Crowley, Tiffany introduce themselves to voters
Crowley, Tiffany put public education at center of Wisconsin governor's race
Wisconsin polling has David Crowley up against Tom Tiffany in gubernatorial race

races.matchup: Andy Biggs (R) vs. Katie Hobbs (D, inc.)
races.summary: Incumbent Gov. Katie Hobbs (D) holds consistent polling leads over Trump-backed Rep. Andy Biggs (R), from about 8 points (AARP, early Aug) to roughly 15 points (HighGround, late Aug), fueled by strong margins with independents and women. Hobbs has launched a multi-million-dollar ad campaign hitting Biggs on inflation and a federal-sales-tax proposal, while the two clash over water policy. Republicans are working to make a pay-to-play investigation into Hobbs a central issue.

races.summary: Open-seat race (Sen. Shaheen retiring); primaries are today, Sept 8. Rep. Chris Pappas is the heavy Democratic favorite (UNH ~61% vs Manzur), and Trump-endorsed former Sen. John Sununu leads the GOP field (~56-60% over Scott Brown). The general is a toss-up and appears to be tightening: a late-August UNH poll showed Pappas's support sliding; surveys split between a narrow Sununu edge and a Pappas 49-42 lead.

races.matchup: Kelly Ayotte (R, inc.) vs. Cinde Warmington (D)
races.summary: Incumbent GOP Gov. Kelly Ayotte leads Democrat Cinde Warmington in the latest UNH poll, 49-39 (late August), with job approval improving to 49%. Warmington was expected to win the Sept 8 Democratic primary and is running on attacks over Ayotte's education-freedom-account program and property taxes. Coverage is largely poll-driven and tilts modestly toward Ayotte.

articles.headline: UNH poll shows Ayotte leads Warmington in NH governor's race
Ayotte's Approval Improves, Lead Over Warmington Grows in New Hampshire Gubernatorial Race

races.summary: Open-seat race (Gov. Laura Kelly term-limited) between GOP Senate President Ty Masterson, who won the Aug 4 primary on a Trump endorsement, and Democratic state Sen. Cindy Holscher. A late-August Holscher internal poll showed a dead heat (47-46), and on Sept 4 Holscher picked up the Kansas AFL-CIO endorsement even as Masterson courts several trade unions. The contest is shaping up as a genuine toss-up.

races.matchup: Kurt Alme (R) vs. Alani Bankhead (D) vs. Seth Bodnar (I)
races.summary: Montana's open Senate seat (Daines retired and endorsed Alme) is a three-way race in which Republican Kurt Alme holds a comfortable lead. Decision Desk HQ's Sept 4 average puts Alme at 44%, independent Seth Bodnar at 26%, and Democrat Alani Bankhead at 21%, with a forecast giving Alme ~9-in-10 odds. Coverage centers on Democratic infighting after Bankhead refused to exit before the Aug 10 withdrawal deadline, a split most analysts say benefits Alme.

races.matchup: Dan Sullivan (R, inc.) vs. Mary Peltola (D)
races.summary: Alaska's ranked-choice Senate race is rated a toss-up, with Democrat Mary Peltola holding a narrow, consistent polling edge over Republican incumbent Dan Sullivan; she led the August primary field and DDHQ's average has her up about 50-48. On Sept 2-3 news broke that President Trump will travel to Alaska about a month out to campaign for Sullivan. A complicating wrinkle is a second Republican named Dan J. Sullivan on the ballot, which the GOP fears could siphon votes and help Peltola clear 50%.

races.matchup: Pete Ricketts (R, inc.) vs. Dan Osborn (I)
races.summary: A genuine tossup on the numbers: a Democratic-aligned Impact Research internal (Aug 9-13) showed Ricketts and Osborn tied at 47%, though forecasters still rate it Likely Republican and markets give Ricketts ~70%. The two met Sept 1 in their first debate at the Nebraska State Fair, clashing over cost of living, tariffs and immigration, with Ricketts branding his independent opponent 'Democrat Dan.'

Ricketts, Osborn talk tariffs, Iran war during Nebraska State Fair debate

races.summary: A pure tossup (Cook; Sabato leans-R): the Overton Insights poll (Aug 24-26) had Talarico 44 to Paxton 43.4, while an Aug 9-11 Emerson/Nexstar survey had Paxton 47-46. Paxton is the challenger, having ousted John Cornyn in the May GOP primary. Coverage skews favorable to Talarico on his fundraising edge (~$30M vs ~$9M) and a viral Paxton 'made with AI' data-center plan; Trump's MAGA Inc. disclosed a $10M IE for Paxton.

races.matchup: Greg Abbott (R, inc.) vs. Gina Hinojosa (D)
races.summary: Abbott is seeking a fourth term and remains the clear favorite (Cook rates it Likely Republican; markets ~81-82%), but coverage centers on an unexpectedly tight contest. An Overton Insights poll (Aug 24-26) had Abbott up just 1 point, 46.9-45.8, and most surveys show a smaller lead than his 11-point 2022 win. Hinojosa runs on public schools and affordability but faces a massive resource gap (~$67M vs ~$3M cash).

articles.headline: Greg Abbott Leads by 1 Point in New Texas Governor Race Poll
New Poll has Gina Hinojosa Within 1 Point of Greg Abbott in Texas Gov Race

races.matchup: Ashley Moody (R, inc.) vs. Angie Nixon (D)
races.summary: Coverage is dominated by the Hope Florida scandal: a leaked Leon County grand-jury report found the state 'misappropriated' $10M of a Medicaid settlement into political causes and faulted appointed Sen. Ashley Moody's (R) office for failing due diligence, though no charges were brought. Democratic nominee Angie Nixon has repeatedly called on Moody to resign and is filing Bar complaints, putting the GOP on defense. Polls still favor Moody by mid-to-high single digits but have been tightening as the scandal fuels Democratic attacks.

For the open seat vacated by primary-defeated Sen. Bill Cassidy, Trump-endorsed Rep. Julia Letlow (R) is the well-funded frontrunner facing Democrat Jamie Davis, a Tensas Parish farmer and the first Black candidate to reach a Louisiana U.S. Senate general election since Reconstruction. Davis is pushing a rural, working-class message and must expand far beyond the Democratic base in a Trump+22 state. An August PPP survey showed Letlow up just 41-37, but she vastly outraises Davis and remains favored.
